epic.title: proof stack sample
epic.note: Dev-only synthetic stack: two unrelated committed ledgers stacked to exercise compose → validate → render offline. Not a real PR chain — a real multi-layer sample awaits per-layer ledgers from the deferred /proof:retrofit-stack skill.
epic.goal: Exercises the deterministic proof.stack/v1 pipeline end-to-end with no network: two committed reduced spines folded into one stack, validated per-layer, and rendered self-contained.

layers.summary: Foundation ledger (decisions only; its diff is not ingested in the offline sample).
